cases.title: Concurrent inventory oversell
cases.invariant: Successful purchased quantity never exceeds initial stock.
cases.oracle: Twenty concurrent orders contend for stock five.
cases.failure: Assertion failure on successful purchases versus available stock
cases.test:
def test_concurrent_orders_never_oversell():
    responses = run_concurrently(orders=20)
    successes = [r for r in responses if r.status_code == 201]
    assert len(successes) <= INITIAL_STOCK
    assert STATE.stock >= 0

cases.title: Inventory lost after decline
cases.invariant: A definite decline leaves no charge, paid order, or lost inventory.
cases.failure: Assertion failure comparing stock before and after decline
cases.test:
def test_decline_releases_inventory():
    before = STATE.stock
    response = create_order(payment_token="decline")
    assert response.status_code == 402
    assert STATE.stock == before
    assert not STATE.payment.charges

cases.title: Duplicate charge after timeout
cases.invariant: One logical checkout produces at most one provider charge.
cases.oracle: Timeout once, retry the same identity, then inspect the provider ledger.
cases.test:
def test_unstable_external_effect_identity():
    response1 = client.post("/orders", json=payload, headers=headers)
    assert response1.status_code == 504

    response2 = client.post("/orders", json=payload, headers=headers)

    # Primary business oracle executes before retry status.
    charges_count = len(STATE.payment.charges)
    assert charges_count == 1, (
        f"Expected exactly 1 charge, but found {charges_count}"
    )
    assert response2.status_code == 201

cases.title: Cancellation restores stock twice
cases.invariant: Cancellation releases reserved inventory exactly once.
cases.oracle: Cancel the same paid order twice and compare stock snapshots.
cases.failure: Assertion failure: stock changed after repeated cancellation
cases.test:
def test_repeated_cancel_releases_once():
    order = create_paid_order()
    first = cancel(order["id"])
    stock_after_first = STATE.stock
    second = cancel(order["id"])
    assert first.status_code == second.status_code == 200
    assert STATE.stock == stock_after_first

cases.title: Client-controlled order price
cases.invariant: Server catalog price is authoritative for orders and charges.
cases.oracle: Submit a conflicting quoted total and inspect order plus provider amount.
cases.test:
def test_server_price_is_authoritative():
    response = client.post(
        "/orders",
        json={"quantity": 1, "quoted_total": 10},
        headers=headers,
    )
    data = response.json()
    charge = next(iter(STATE.payment.charges.values()))
    assert data["total"] == CATALOG_PRICE
    assert charge["amount"] == CATALOG_PRICE
